description: [GA4 WRITE] Create a key event (conversion) on a GA4 property. Requires GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

body.description: Raw request-body object (JSON) merged OVER the typed fields — use for nested/advanced fields not exposed as flat args.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

countingMethod.description: How the key event is counted. Default ONCE_PER_EVENT.

eventName.description: The event name to mark as a key event (e.g. "purchase").

name: ga4_create_key_event
